title: Make a keyed list
summary: An each block repeats markup for a list.
introduction: An each block repeats markup for a list. Your task: Add a third book with id 3.
learningObjectives: Add a third book with id 3.
Explain the example for make a keyed list

blocks.text: An each block repeats markup for a list. A key identifies each item even when its position changes.
Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.

blocks.code:
{#each books as book (book.id)}
  • {book.title}
    • {/each}
blocks.title: Make a keyed list

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A Svelte each block repeats its markup for each item. The expression in parentheses supplies the item key.

blocks.text: The two titles appear as list items with stable book ids.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a unique stable id. A repeated key cannot identify two different items.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a third book with id 3.
